subsystems.name: Diamond sensor chip
subsystems.role: Contains nitrogen-vacancy centres whose spin states respond to magnetic fields.

subsystems.name: Optical excitation and collection
subsystems.role: Polarises NV spins with green light and collects red fluorescence to read spin state.

subsystems.name: Microwave manipulation
subsystems.role: Applies microwave pulses to manipulate NV spin states for field sensing.

subsystems.name: Magnetic field control
subsystems.role: Provides a stable bias field and cancels ambient magnetic noise.

subsystems.name: Sample positioning
subsystems.role: Places the specimen within a few micrometres of the diamond surface.

subsystems.name: Data acquisition and analysis
subsystems.role: Synchronises laser, microwave and camera, then reconstructs magnetic field maps.
parts: software for lock-in detection and image processing

buildSteps.title: Prepare diamond with NV centres
buildSteps.detail: A diamond is grown by chemical vapour deposition with controlled nitrogen doping, then irradiated and annealed to form nitrogen-vacancy centres at a known depth.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the sensor chip
buildSteps.detail: The diamond is thinned and polished to a flat surface, and a microwave antenna is patterned on or near it for spin manipulation.

buildSteps.title: Build the optical path
buildSteps.detail: A 532 nm laser is focused through an objective onto the diamond; fluorescence is collected through the same objective, filtered to remove green light, and imaged onto a sensitive camera.

buildSteps.title: Integrate microwave delivery
buildSteps.detail: Microwave electronics are connected to the antenna so that pulses can be applied uniformly across the field of view.

buildSteps.title: Add field control and shielding
buildSteps.detail: Helmholtz coils set a bias field and magnetic shielding reduces ambient noise to below the signal of interest.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate the instrument
buildSteps.detail: Known magnetic fields are applied to measure sensitivity, spatial resolution and any systematic errors.

buildSteps.title: Mount and align the sample
buildSteps.detail: The specimen is placed on a piezo stage and brought within micrometres of the diamond surface.

buildSteps.title: Acquire and reconstruct images
buildSteps.detail: A sequence of laser and microwave pulses is applied while the camera records fluorescence; software converts the images into quantitative magnetic field maps.

prerequisites.why: NV centres can be created reliably by ion implantation or during growth.
532 nm lasers and low-noise cameras are standard laboratory equipment.
Sources and amplifiers for the 2.87 GHz NV resonance are widely available.
High-permeability alloys can reduce ambient fields to the required level.
Photolithography and metal deposition can pattern microwave structures on diamond.

pathway.milestone: Research-grade wide-field NV magnetometers in physics and biology labs
pathway.unlocks: Imaging magnetic fields from single cells, thin films and geological samples.

pathway.milestone: Turnkey commercial instruments with automated operation
pathway.unlocks: Broader use by non-specialists in materials science and biology.

pathway.milestone: Improved sensitivity and spatial resolution through optimized diamond and optics
pathway.unlocks: Detection of weaker magnetic signals, such as from single neurons.

pathway.milestone: Integration with other microscopy modalities and clinical translation
pathway.unlocks: Label-free magnetic imaging in medicine and materials quality control.
